summary: IMPLEMENTED: orchestrator/dev_supervisor/state_store.py (crash-safe machine-local store: envelope with schema_version and sha256 checksum, temp file + flush + fsync + os.replace with bounded retries for Windows sharing violations, atomic backup of the previous valid file, damaged file quarantined and recovered from backup or refused if both are damaged, newer schema refused, stale temp files from a hard crash removed on open, append-only events.jsonl tolerant of a torn last line, scrub of credential keys and credential-shaped values on every write, extended-length path prefix for long Windows paths, single-supervisor lock; default directory %LOCALAPPDATA%/CreatorStudio/dev_supervisor or XDG state dir, overridable by CREATORSTUDIO_DEV_SUPERVISOR_DIR, refused inside any git working tree). workers.py: Worker record (id, role, task_id, branch, worktree, owner stream, provider/model, status, pid, session id, started/last-heartbeat, restart count, failures, last result reference) and a WorkerRegistry persisted in the store with duplicate prevention per task and per normalised worktree. lifecycle.py: Supervisor with assign (injected worktree/branch checker), spawn (STARTING persisted before launch), monitor (exit codes, heartbeat and activity-based stale detection, bounded runtime), restart (exponential backoff, restart budget, BLOCKED plus blocker record after N identical failures, human unblock), graceful stop with kill after grace, collect (REPORTED until an injected verifier decides; contradictory reports from two workers detected, flagged and blocking VERIFIED until one side is REJECTED), and recover (reload, reconcile pids, mark vanished workers LOST, plan only, never launches or signals). ClaudeCliLauncher builds an argument list [claude, -p, --output-format, stream-json, --verbose, --model M, --session-id UUID] (shell=False, prompt file on stdin, output to log files, own process group) and never signals a pid it did not start; GitWorktreeChecker uses git argument lists with a timeout. TESTED: 88 offline tests pass (fake launcher, fake clock, fake popen, fake git runner, sockets blocked). OBSERVED: argv construction only, pid probe, executable resolution. NOT TESTED: the real launcher has never started a claude process; that stdin prompt delivery with -p and the --verbose requirement for stream-json behave as assumed is NOT TESTED; GitWorktreeChecker against a real repository is NOT TESTED; nothing is VERIFIED.
